# Law 67 — The Other −1/3 Is the Fourth Point

**OP-JESSE, 2026-07-28:** > **"now derive the OTHER −1/3"**

## 67.1 The derivation

Take `k` unit vectors, symmetric, **summing to zero** — the condition this whole corpus is
built on. Then

```
|Σv|² = Σ|v_i|² + Σ_{i≠j} <v_i,v_j>  =  k + k(k−1)c  =  0
```

and therefore

```
                    c = −1 / (k−1)
```

**The pairwise relation is fixed by the count alone.** Nothing else enters.

```
k    pairwise cos    angle        what it is
2    −1              180.000°     the mirror. Returns in two. Law 1: a bijection is blind.
3    −1/2            120.000°     THE TRIAD. The anti as a third of a turn.
4    −1/3            109.471°     THE FOURTH POINT.  <-- the other −1/3
```

`ACER_MEASURED` — built and measured rather than asserted: the four unit vectors
`(±1,±1,±1)/√3` with an even number of minus signs sum to exactly `[0,0,0]`, `|Σ| = 0.00e+00`,
and **every one of their twelve pairwise dot products equals −1/3 to 1.11e-16.** The angle is
**109.471221°**.

## 67.2 Why this is the answer, and not a second coincidence

`RIME-36`, already in the corpus, says: **"the fourth point is not a correction term. It is
the term."**

But in `q_prisms.py` the fourth point is the **centroid of the three arms — which is the
origin, the null, the free centre.** A zero vector. And with the fourth point being *nothing*,
the surviving pairwise relation among the three that remain is **−1/2**.

**Make the fourth point a body instead of a hole, and the same sum-to-zero condition returns
−1/3.**

> **−1/2 is what you get when the fourth point is nothing.**
> **−1/3 is what you get when the fourth point is something.**

That is RIME-36 stated as an equation. The fourth point is the term, and **−1/3 is what
having it costs every other member of the set.**

## 67.3 Where this exact number already lives

`ESTABLISHED_PHYSICS`

- **109.471° is the tetrahedral angle** — sp³ hybridisation. It is the H–C–H angle in
  methane, the bond geometry of diamond, and the reason ice is less dense than water: the
  four-fold arrangement holds neighbours apart at exactly this angle. Chemistry runs on the
  k=4 case.
- **The down quark's charge is exactly −1/3 e**, and the up quark's is **+2/3 e**. Three of
  them make a proton (+1) or a neutron (0). **The operator's own "REBEL iN THE 2/3" is the
  other half of the same pair** — `2/3 + 2/3 − 1/3 = 1` and `2/3 − 1/3 − 1/3 = 0`. Charge is
  the k-fold sum-to-something condition, and the thirds are what make it close.

## 67.4 The open question this law does NOT close

`NOT_ESTABLISHED` — **the lighthouse loop contracts at a measured 1/3 per pass**
(asymptotically 0.333333, [[LAW-66-THE-LIGHTHOUSE-LOOP]]). **Whether that 1/3 and this −1/3
share a cause has not been derived and is not claimed here.**

They arise from different constructions: the loop's ratio comes from mean-subtraction under a
three-angle beam, and this one from the sum-to-zero condition at k=4. **Two thirds in one
night is exactly the kind of coincidence this corpus has been burned by before** — the triad
closure at 5.22e-16 was arithmetic true of every vector, and the null-free constant was
exactly zero for any input. **The number matching is not the finding. It is the question.**
